principle: Forms and skins are independent. A semantic skin compiles into every canonical form.

semantic_source_map.head: top-center crop
semantic_source_map.body: detected foreground bounds or full image fallback

arbitrary_image_policy: Any uploaded image is accepted. Foreground is approximated from alpha/background contrast, then split into semantic regions. Missing or bad regions degrade visually but do not invalidate the skin.
production_path: Compile skin + form + poses offline to a spritesheet. Runtime draws one atlas frame instead of deforming a 3D mesh.
reference_image_interpretation: Use simple 2D pose silhouettes with implied volume; do not require one geometrically consistent 3D model across poses.
